svg.title: Mobility Computation Lab — Boston zoning and physical access
svg.desc: A restyled detail of the original Boston project figure, preserving its road paths, 177 fine-zone centroids, nine parent-zone boundaries, and 139 physical access points. Documented city cases, GMNS workflows, and traffic-assignment experiments, developed under the guidance of Prof. Xuesong Zhou.

g.text: Documented city cases, GMNS workflows, and traffic-assignment experiments.
Developed under the guidance of Prof. Xuesong Zhou.
